# ISSUE-272 / PR #321: exact scheduling and integrated seed-test revision

This revision addresses REVIEW.md findings 1–4 for AC1/AC2: select the exact test-only Linux heuristic below and integrate the deterministic seed-observation repair. Only PLAN.md and TEST_PLAN.md change in this planning turn. No further timing runs or implementation occur. Return these exact artifacts through the existing agent review gate; no human gate is introduced.

## Dimensions

Approved small / unknown / standard, investigation profile; retain these settings. The bounded combined change and verification fit the 16-hour claim budget; no separate CI-only cycle or generic framework is planned.

## What we know

- `internal/cli/native_integration_test.go:19` dispatches internal-tools before isolation; :32–60 own user directories, m.Run, cleanup and exit.
- `internal/cli/fixture_helpers_test.go:227` defines cliFixtureSeed; :237 eligibility observations occur before :276 populate selection. Root read errors propagate, while non-absence config-probe errors produce fallback. Source inspection confirmed this order.
- Existing fixture tests at :463, :492, :532, :604, :645, :694, :733 cover equivalence, sticky errors, lifetime, allocation order, both eight-caller publication cells, managed digests and mock controls. Preserve all names/assertions/scenarios.
- `internal/cli/environment_test.go:132,176` exercise parallel fixture and resolver/runner isolation. Its :25,67 env-mutating tests and fixture helpers :739,747 remain serial.
- Makefile `check` depends on lint, repository race and changelog-check. Production, protected paths, other packages and limit changes remain excluded.
- REVIEW_EVIDENCE.md (including carried-forward design/test plan), CI.md and PR_REVIEW_EVIDENCE.md were read as attributed evidence, not authority. CI failures are consistent with seed ineligibility but the triggering input is unverified. Prior raw diagnostic logs are unavailable here. Reported default/explicit-16 package times 137.183s/88.881s show 35.2099% diagnostic benefit, not final acceptance.

## What we're assuming

Ordinary initial-namespace Linux unified hierarchies can meet the narrow supported subset below; deterministic fixtures verify its algorithm even if this sandbox falls back. Final real-provider status and benefit are measured after implementation. Reported baseline/rebase ancestry must be confirmed in metadata-bearing checkouts; this snapshot has no .git. No additional planning benchmark is needed.

## Open questions

Final real implicit admission versus fallback, matched-host >=30% reduction, suite 120s objective, race and full-suite co-scheduling remain pending; TEST_PLAN defines their checks. The CI triggering input remains unknown and need not block the deterministic repair. Neither gap requires privileged/all-platform proof or another approval gate.

## Architectural context and bounded evidence

Existing t.Parallel annotations permit concurrency but Go's small implicit default can serialize runnable work. Only those existing annotations schedule differently. Reported historical seed-only medians 127.808860s to 125.234768s (2.014%) were insufficient; do not substitute them for final combined acceptance.

Exactly two sequential complete CLI invocations ran in this reopening, on unchanged source, Go 1.26.10 linux/amd64, GOMAXPROCS=2, GOFLAGS=`-buildvcs=false -p=2`:

```bash
go test -count=1 -json ./internal/cli/
go test -count=1 -json ./internal/cli/ -parallel=16
```

The second began only after the control exited 0 and its complete JSON/stderr showed no failures or resource-error signatures. Each passed **836 tests/subtests**, with **three identical existing authenticated skips**, no fail events, and exactly equal terminal name/outcome maps (839 entries). No assertion/source changes, full suite, extra package run, timing loop, CPU/process/memory/file-limit or boundary changes occurred. No race/make-check run occurred. Launcher stream-fd denial messages also occur on read-only commands, outside Go logs; neither test invocation failed or logged such a resource failure.

## Exact scheduling decision (review finding 1)

Let D be testing's original implicit parallel value, E mean `FlagSet.Visit` found an explicitly parsed `test.parallel`, and O be an immutable observation result. Apply rows in order; an invalid value is never repaired by this helper.

| Condition | Result | Resource reads |
| --- | --- | --- |
| E, any platform/value (including equal to D) | Preserve parsed value exactly; testing retains validation | None |
| Implicit, non-Linux | D | None |
| Implicit Linux D <= 1 | D | None |
| Implicit Linux D > 16 | 16 | None |
| Implicit Linux D = 16 | 16 | None |
| Implicit Linux D = 2..15, complete valid O meets all thresholds | 16 | One bounded observation |
| Implicit Linux D = 2..15, any failed/unsupported observation or threshold | D, with no partial increase | One bounded observation at most |

Thresholds: effective memory >=4294967296 bytes (4 GiB), the minimum of host MemAvailable and every applicable finite ancestor `memory.max - memory.current`; each applicable finite ancestor `pids.max - pids.current` >=1024; RLIMIT_NPROC soft >=4096 or `unlimited`. Explicit cgroup `max` means known unlimited. All-unlimited PID ancestors satisfy that condition. NPROC is a soft-limit heuristic, not remaining per-user slots. These observations reserve nothing and are a test scheduling heuristic, not a hard resource guarantee or security authority.

In `TestMain`, retain internal-tools dispatch as the first branch. Within the existing isolated-directory lifetime, parse flags once if not already parsed, then inspect Visit. Preserve parse errors, duplicate/last-wins and testing's later positive-value validation, help/DefValue, unrelated values and args. Read the registered value without replacing its registration; update its Value directly only when the decision changes it, never FlagSet.Set (which would mark it explicit), and never rewrite DefValue. The pure helper consumes original D, explicitness, GOOS and a value observation; it does not read flags/files or mutate globals. A small application wrapper decides whether to call the provider at all, then applies the result. Applying twice is idempotent, including the implicit fallback and 16 branches. Retain `m.Run`, cleanup and exit status; no injected process-wide override or new operator flag.

## Bounded Linux observation subset (review finding 2)

Implement test-only `cliTestParallelObservation`, `observeCLITestParallel`, `decideCLITestParallel`, `applyCLITestParallel`, and bounded parsing/reader helpers in existing `internal/cli/fixture_helpers_test.go`. TestMain in existing `internal/cli/native_integration_test.go` wires the real provider. Provider dependencies are passed by value (bounded read and readlink functions); fixture byte strings, errors and record slices are copied/frozen before use. The returned record owns its ancestor values and validity/reason enum; no shared mutable maps/slices or global test override. Real reads happen only for Linux implicit 2..15. Use portable `os`, `io`, `strings`, `strconv`, `path/filepath`, `runtime` APIs, reading NPROC from text rather than syscall.Getrlimit/RLIMIT_NPROC. No Linux-only imports, constants or APIs enter common files. All additions remain in these two existing files; **no new test file is planned**, so no new-file absence check applies. Operator absence check: not applicable because no file is new. Any later proposed new file must be checked against the approved base and reflected in the revised touchpoints; this snapshot has no Git metadata for that check.

Supported subset is ordinary Linux procfs and a single, full-root unified cgroup-v2 hierarchy in the initial cgroup namespace, with visible root and all membership ancestors. This is deliberately narrower than container/delegated layouts:

1. Read `/proc/self/cgroup`, `/proc/self/mountinfo`, `/proc/meminfo`, `/proc/self/limits`; readlink `/proc/self/ns/cgroup` and `/proc/1/ns/cgroup`. Require both links exactly `cgroup:[4026531835]`, the Linux initial cgroup namespace identifier for this supported subset. Different/unknown identifiers, unreadable PID1 links, or kernels not exposing this identifier fall back; equality of two arbitrary namespace links alone is insufficient. This is a narrow layout recognition rule, never security authority. Require membership exactly one `0::<absolute path>` record, no v1/hybrid records, colon ambiguity or duplicate membership.
2. Parse mountinfo's separator and mandatory fields, allowing ordinary optional fields within bounds. Reject any `cgroup` filesystem and require exactly one `cgroup2` entry with decoded mount root `/`. Multiple/bind/subtree cgroup2 mounts, nested mounts at or below its mountpoint, or missing/ambiguous mappings fall back. Decode only mountinfo octal escapes `\040`, `\011`, `\012`, `\134`; reject unknown/incomplete escapes and decoded NUL/control characters. For simplicity reject decoded backslashes too. Mountpoint must be an absolute clean path. Membership must be absolute and clean; reject empty components, `.`/`..`, repeated separators, trailing slash except `/`, NUL/control/backslash and paths over 4096 bytes. Never join an absolute membership directly: remove its initial slash, join below the mountpoint, and verify `filepath.Rel` containment, including component boundaries. Reject symlink components using Lstat from mountpoint through the leaf, symlink resource files and nonregular resource files. Mountinfo decoding precedes path checks.
3. Read mount-root `cgroup.controllers` and require both memory and pids tokens exactly once; unsupported/missing controllers fall back. Traverse membership leaf to full mount root inclusively, maximum 64 directories total. At every non-root directory read `memory.max`, `memory.current`, `pids.max`, `pids.current`; include every intermediate parent, not just leaf. The genuine hierarchy root has no limiting max interfaces by cgroup-v2 semantics and is intrinsically unlimited; identify it only after the full-root/initial-namespace checks, and require its controllers observation. Do not mistake missing files at a non-root node for root unlimited. A root-membership process has no finite cgroup ancestors and still requires host memory/NPROC and supported topology.
4. Scalar files permit one ASCII unsigned base-10 uint64 token and an optional final newline, with `max` allowed only in max files. Reject signs, empty/extra tokens, overflow and current=`max`. Read current even when max is unlimited, so unavailable controllers/read errors remain failure. For finite max require current <= max before subtraction; equality yields zero, excess is invalid. `MemAvailable:` must appear exactly once in meminfo as unsigned decimal followed by exact `kB`, multiply by 1024 with overflow checking. Other well-formed meminfo lines may be ignored. Require exactly one `Max processes` limits row; parse soft/hard columns and final units `processes`, accepting unsigned decimal or exact `unlimited`, validate both columns and use soft only. Reject missing/duplicate target rows, malformed lines and nondecimal numeric forms. Do not use MemFree, hard NPROC, or guessed limits as substitutes.
5. Bound every text read using limit+1 then require EOF within limit, never accept truncated prefixes. Caps: mountinfo 256 KiB/2048 records; meminfo 64 KiB/512 records; limits 16 KiB/128 records; membership 8 KiB/16 records (only one accepted); controllers 4096 bytes/1 record; scalar 128 bytes/1 record; any text line <=4096 bytes. Namespace links <=128 bytes; every path <=4096 bytes, <=64 components. At most 64 ancestor directories and 256 resource scalar reads; aggregate text <=512 KiB and <=300 file reads, no retries. Check limits before allocation/traversal. Failure, exhaustion, inaccessible/missing input, malformed/truncated/overflowed content, unsupported topology or root-containment failure makes O invalid and retains D. Re-read membership, namespace links and mountinfo at completion within these same total budgets and require exact equality; a detected mapping change falls back. Concurrent resource changes still make this observational rather than a reservation.

No generic resource framework, privileged probe, all-platform resource proof, limit adjustment, CPU/GOMAXPROCS/build-concurrency change or security-policy change. Non-Linux compilation uses these portable text helpers and never probes procfs at runtime. Unsupported layouts are expected conservative fallback, not a reason to broaden scope.

## Integrated implementation sequence and boundaries

1. Add the immutable record, pure decision helper, portable bounded text provider/parsers and deterministic matrix in fixture_helpers_test.go. Add fresh-FlagSet application tests before wiring TestMain. Use proposed new test names prefixed TestCLITestParallel; do not rename existing tests.
2. Wire applyCLITestParallel into TestMain after dispatch and within its existing isolation/cleanup path. Default wiring uses the real observer, not a fixture constant. Add bounded nonrecursive real-TestMain subprocess checks described in TEST_PLAN.
3. Implement the per-instance seed observation repair below in the same change, preserving initialization/copy behavior and every existing assertion.
4. Audit source and test inventories, run focused deterministic/isolation tests at explicit one and deterministic admitted sixteen, then required checks/race/full-suite co-scheduling and final quiet matched-host measurements. Capture a small immutable startup decision record (original/final integer and reason enum). Write at most one 1KiB telemetry file `parallel-policy.json` inside the existing isolated TestMain root, before m.Run; normal root cleanup removes it. A measurement harness with its own private TMPDIR may collect it while the test runs, without changing scheduling inputs or publishing paths. Record actual implicit policy status without environment/path logging. Acceptance remains pending until those checks succeed.

All existing serial env/stdin/cwd cases remain serial: environment_test.go:25,66; fixture_helpers_test.go:739,747; native_integration_test.go:173; managed_root_test.go:25; plan_test.go:139; submit_description_test.go:49,151; split_recommendation_test.go:159,188,206,222, plus process mutations in checkpoint_reconcile, cleanup, diagnostics, doctor, go_fastpass, migrate_refs, submit_freshness and validation_output tests. Recheck by source search for Setenv, os.Stdin, os.Chdir and t.Chdir. No new t.Parallel on existing tests; no skip, timeout, assertion, scenario, fixture limit or production change.

## Integrated deterministic seed repair (review finding 4)

Modify only `internal/cli/fixture_helpers_test.go` for this component:

1. Factor cliFixtureInputKey into a real observation provider and pure decision/key function. Add an immutable per-instance provider field to cliFixtureSeed, set before concurrent populate calls; nil uses the real provider. Preserve the existing cliFixtureInputKey wrapper/default callers. Proposed test-only input record includes root-read result, template value, ordered config-probe absence/error observations, basename and environment entries. Preserve observation order/short-circuit behavior and error semantics, including root read errors versus non-absence config errors. Use staged provider operations: read root first, then template, then the four ordered probes until rejection, and only then basename/environment; never eagerly observe later stages after an earlier rejection. A per-instance immutable provider may return frozen stage results; the real provider reads each requested stage. The pure key decision consumes the resulting owned record. Spy fixtures assert stages not reached are never observed. Preserve basename plus sorted environment key excluding only SWARM_MOCK_*.
2. Set deterministic eligible providers on local cells in SeedErrors (:492), SeedLifetimeAndIsolation (:532), ConcurrentPublication (:645), and use the same explicit provider/decision seam in MockControlsPreserveSeedEligibility (:733). Retain every assertion, name, eight callers per cell, both success/failure cells, sticky errors, real initialize/copy, lifetime cleanup and mutations. No global eligibility override and no host config mutation.
3. Add deterministic eligible/ineligible matrix tests: every config path absent/present/error independently, templates, nonempty/unreadable root, basename/environment changes, mock-only changes. Verify fallback initializes the original requested root without selection/publication. Add separate default-provider integration coverage that predicts the policy-selected branch from real observations and exercises populate, without skipping on an ineligible host. Deterministic eligible coverage must always run.
4. Preserve deep byte/mode/path/managed-digest/tree equivalence, independent Git objects/index/refs/config/store/env, no shared inodes/alternates, seed immutability, allocation order and TestMain cleanup. The injection changes only what local invariant tests observe, never initializer/copy semantics or default eligibility policy. No CI speedup is assigned to this repair.


## HANDOFF

- Modify only existing `internal/cli/native_integration_test.go:19` TestMain and `internal/cli/fixture_helpers_test.go:227,237,276` seed/provider/decision entry points. New symbols and test functions go in these existing files; no new file, operator absence check unnecessary unless that scope changes. /swarm-plan was read from `.claude/commands/swarm-plan.md`; only the two requested artifacts were written.
- Extend fixture tests at :463,492,532,604,645,694,733; retain environment_test.go:132,176 unchanged and use their coverage in verification. Implement exact decision table and supported subset above, not a developer-selected policy.
- Focused commands: `go test -count=1 ./internal/cli/ -run '^TestCLITestParallel'`; `go test -count=1 ./internal/cli/ -run '^TestCLIFixture'`; `go test -race -count=3 -shuffle=on ./internal/cli/ -run '^(TestCLITestParallel|TestCLIFixture|TestCLIParallelFixtureIsolation|TestCLIResolverRunnerIsolation)'`. TEST_PLAN supplies explicit-1/16 isolation and final acceptance commands. These are future implementation checks, not planning runs.
- Checked by reading source: dispatch/lifetime, eligibility-before-selection, root-error/config-fallback order, existing scenario names and Makefile dependencies. Prior controlled evidence is attributed; final results are unmeasured.
- Reopen rather than widen if production/protected/other-package edits, new files, changed assertions/scenarios, provider semantic drift, resource failures or inadequate final reduction are needed. Unsupported hosts fall back; they do not require broadening the observer. Never relax limits or acceptance.
- **What this change breaks**: implicit test.parallel at TestMain changes only per table; add default/explicit/metadata/dispatch regressions. SeedErrors/Lifetime/ConcurrentPublication/MockControls (:492,532,645,733) currently depend on host eligibility; replace that assumption with local deterministic providers while preserving every assertion. Preserve newCLIFixture (:98), allocation order (:604), stores/env/Git independence, #303 process mock behavior, managed digests and all serial mutation sites. Prior source search identified a stale serial-fixture comment in `.github/workflows/swarm-validate.yml`; preserve that protected file unchanged. Makefile/check, production call sites, docs/templates and all test names remain unchanged.

# ISSUE-272 / PR #321 verification plan

Current approved scope is test-only scheduling of existing parallel cases plus integrated deterministic seed-test repair. No implicit scheduling default is selected by this evidence-gap plan. Independent review uses the agent gate; no human gate is added. The operator's two-run planning budget is exhausted.

## Completed bounded investigation

```bash
go test -count=1 -json ./internal/cli/
# Only after successful control and inspection for failures/resource errors:

```

Complete terminal name/outcome maps match exactly. Both stderr logs are empty, no fail events or searched process/thread/memory/descriptor resource-error signatures appeared. Recurring launcher stream-fd denials occur outside Go logs on read-only commands too. No boundary or limit was adjusted.

Raw logs, monotonic timing summaries and /proc samples live under `$TMPDIR/issue272-default/` and `$TMPDIR/issue272-parallel16/`, each with `stdout.jsonl`, `stderr.log`, `samples.jsonl`, `summary.json`. PLAN records all soft/hard rlimits and sampled process/thread/RSS peaks. Sampling included the Go root and observable descendants about every 0.5s without argv/env. Missing/reparented/short-lived processes, non-atomic reads and RSS shared-page double counting limit interpretation. Samples are not hard bounds or available-headroom measurements. No full suite, race test, make check, source edits, extra complete package invocation, test timing loop or resource/boundary changes were performed. No further planning tests are proposed. ## CI component focused regressions (for a complete reviewed implementation)

Actual CI input remains unverified. The deterministic matrix proves branch behavior only. Implement this component together with a supported performance design in one cycle; do not run broad checks on a CI-only milestone and reopen for performance.

Preserve all existing TestCLIFixture tests, assertions, subtest names and scenarios; extend only fixture_helpers_test.go:

- SeedErrors: deterministic eligible local provider, exactly one initializer invocation, sticky sentinel, no partial publication; retain unsafe-tree, symlink, path-bound and copy errors.
- SeedLifetimeAndIsolation: real initializer/copy; first caller cleanup, six concurrent equal/different-key mutations, immutable seed and later copy; retain exact bytes/modes, no shared inode, Git/config/ref/object/index and tracker independence.
- ConcurrentPublication: both success/failure cells, all eight callers each, one initializer, complete publication/sticky failure and lost-seed copy failure. No fallback hides seed failures.
- MockControlsPreserveSeedEligibility: deterministic pristine observations; unchanged mock-excluded key, actual process mock lookup and custom-template rejection. Preserve #303 process behavior.
- Guard matrix: root empty/nonempty/read error, custom templates, each of the four config probes absent/present/non-absence error independently, basename and non-mock environment differences, mock-only changes. Assert original short-circuit/error semantics and key bytes. Count fallback initialization on the requested root with no selection/publication; differing eligible keys retain fallback behavior. Providers are immutable per instance before concurrency, never global overrides.
- Default integration: independently observe real inputs and predict eligibility, exercise the nil/default provider and populate; assert that the policy-selected branch executes real initialization/copy. Pass on eligible and ineligible hosts without skips or relaxed deterministic cases. Avoid logging private environment/config paths. CI cause can only be claimed after reproduction of its input/guard.
- Retain original exact generated paths/bytes/modes/project name, managed digest and policy-overwrite relationship, clean Git tree/index/status/identity, allocation order and seed lifetime. Fresh stores/managers/env and deep independent copies are mandatory; no shared mutable caches, Git alternates or hardlinks.
